title: Yasinia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Perhaps it is a place name, the one cited in Zevachim 112a as Rav Chiya of Yushehinia.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim paragraph names Rav Chiya of Yustinya. Hyman’s regional spelling Yushehinia is retained, along with his tentative identification of the place name.

Beitzah 8b has Rabbi Yose bar Yasinia, beside Hyman’s ben. The checked Bekhorot parallel is at 47b and names Rabbi Shimon Yasinia without bar, beside Hyman’s bar and 46b. Zevachim 112a names Rav Chiyya of Yustinya. The supplied spellings, patronymic forms and locators are retained, and Hyman’s possible place-name explanation does not establish a shared father or an identity between the notices.
